name: Busto Arsizio (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Busto Arsizio (two letters B, red on white and white on red).
history: Municipal flag of Busto Arsizio, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Busto Arsizio arms — two letters B counterchanged red and white, crowned
